press_references.value: The open-source AI red-teaming tool used by Fortune 500 companies is now part of OpenAI

product_launches.description: Promptfoo launched its commercial AI red-teaming and security platform in 2024 after initially starting as an open-source project.

overview_description.description: Promptfoo enables developers to run automated tests that simulate user interactions and potential attack scenarios such as prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, data leakage, and misuse of integrated tools. Promptfoo integrates with development workflows through command line interfaces, configuration files, and connections to version control and continuous integration pipelines. Its system evaluates prompts, models, and agent behaviors against defined test cases to identify vulnerabilities and performance issues during development. The software also provides reporting and remediation guidance that helps teams address findings and monitor AI application behavior across deployment environments.

about_short_description.short_description: Promptfoo develops software tools that support testing, evaluation, and security analysis of applications built with language models.

product.name: Red Teaming
product.description: Automated security testing for AI applications, agents, and RAG systems that identifies vulnerabilities such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leaks, and unsafe tool use.

product.name: Evaluations
product.description: A testing and evaluation toolkit for comparing prompts, language models, outputs, and RAG pipelines against defined quality, accuracy, safety, and performance criteria.

product.name: Model Security
product.description: Security assessment for AI models that scans model files, tests model behavior against attacks, benchmarks models, and maps findings to security and compliance frameworks.

product.name: Guardrails
product.description: Adaptive protection for AI applications that detects and blocks jailbreaks, adversarial attacks, unsafe content, and other model or application risks at runtime.

product.name: Code Scanning
product.description: AI security scanning for development environments and CI/CD pipelines that identifies vulnerabilities in LLM applications and provides findings during the software development process.

product.name: MCP Proxy
product.description: A security proxy for Model Context Protocol communications that helps organizations control, inspect, and protect interactions between AI applications and MCP servers or tools.
